children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may test a support at 4,868 ringgit per metric ton, a break below could open the way toward the 4,811 ringgit-4,844 ringgit range.
The contract has broken a higher support at 4,902 ringgit. The next support will be at 4,868 ringgit, the 76.4% retracmeent of the rise from 4,811 ringgit to 5,050 ringgit.

A break above 4,902 ringgit, now a resistance, may lead to a gain into the 4,931 ringgit-4,959 ringgit range. On the daily chart, the market is consolidating within a range of 4,814 ringgit to 5,032 ringgit.
It is hard to tell where the contract is headed to, until it leaves the range. A break below 4,814 ringgit will confirm a triple-top top and a target of 4,638 ringgit.
Although the market seems to be falling toward 4,814 ringgit, the pattern within the range may turn out to be bullish, as a wave C from 4,462 ringgit looks incomplete.
